field.name: event_date
field.label: Date
field.description: Date of the Event (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: event_date_end
field.label: Last Date
field.description: Last date of the holiday (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: event_time
field.label: Time
field.description: Time the Event starts

field.name: title
field.label: Title
field.description: Title of the Event

field.name: group_code
field.label: Group code
field.description: Four character Group code, or two character Area code

field.name: location
field.label: Location
field.description: Where the Event is being held

field.name: details
field.label: Details
field.description: Description of the Event (used as the Agenda for Committee meetings)

field.name: reports
field.label: Reports
field.description: Reports from the Officers

field.name: minutes
field.label: Minutes
field.description: Minutes of the meeting

field.name: url
field.label: Weblink
field.description: Link to a related website

field.name: url_description
field.label: Weblink desc
field.description: Description of the link

field.name: attachments
field.label: Attachment
field.description: File to be included

field.name: attachment_description
field.label: Attachment desc
field.description: Description of the attachment

field.name: bookable
field.label: Bookable
field.description: Are bookings required for this event

field.name: requires_payment
field.label: Requires payment
field.description: Does attending this event require payment

field.name: max_bookings
field.label: Max Bookings
field.description: Maximum number of bookings acceptable for the Event

field.name: waiting_list_enabled
field.label: Waiting list
field.description: If the event is full, allow users to join a waiting list

field.name: notify_organiser
field.label: Notify organiser
field.description: If Yes, an email will be sent to the Organiser whenever a booking is made

field.name: multi_guest_enabled
field.label: Multi-guest booking
field.description: Allow a booker to bring more than one guest

field.name: max_guests
field.label: Max guests per booking
field.description: Maximum number of additional guests a booker may bring, not counting themselves

field.name: booking_info
field.label: Booking information
field.description: Message to be shown when a booking is made, e.g. payment details

field.name: booking1
field.label: Custom 1
field.description: First custom field for Bookings

field.name: booking1_hint
field.label: Custom 1 - hint
field.description: Hint to be shown for first custom field

field.name: booking2
field.label: Custom 2
field.description: Second custom field for Bookings

field.name: booking2_hint
field.label: Custom 2 - hint
field.description: Hint to be shown for second custom field

field.name: shareable
field.label: Shareable
field.description: Can this event be shared via the website interface

field.name: share_date
field.label: Share Date
field.description: Event will not be available to the API before this date

field.name: publication_date
field.label: Publication Date
field.description: Event will not be displayed before this date
